title: IronHouse — Adaptive Fitness Platform
description: A full‑stack adaptive workout app that plans each day's training from a per‑muscle fatigue‑decay model instead of a fixed calendar — covered by 39 engine tests across 15 user scenarios. Ships real Web Push notifications, an installable PWA, and offline session sync.
invariant: Safety invariant: a fatigued or reported‑painful muscle can never be a training target — enforced in code, and the Claude‑powered AI coach inherits that rule and can't override it.

title: Voice Transcription & Summarizer
description: Real‑time speech‑to‑text tool that transcribes mic input and generates AI summaries, chunking audio in 5‑second windows for low latency.

title: AI Chatbot Framework
description: Modular multi‑model chatbot with GPT‑4 and Claude as swappable backends, context management, token streaming, and agentic tool‑use.

title: Python Game Suite + AI Opponent
description: Five-plus games — Snake, Tetris, Platformer — built from scratch; the Snake variant's AI opponent uses BFS pathfinding.

title: Hackathon Projects — AI & Robotics
description: Multi‑award winner (2022–2024) for an ML‑powered obstacle‑avoidance robot and an NLP text classifier, both built under 24‑hour constraints.
